newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti says aims to meet Consob deadline.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti says aims to meet Consob deadline.

text.p: Information technology group Olivetti, which on Monday was given one day to reply to seven queries by stock market watchdog Consob, said late on Tuesday it was working to respect this deadline.
An Olivetti spokeswoman said: "Olivetti is working to respect this deadline," but she added no statement on the information given to Consob was likely to be published.
A Consob spokesman said on Monday the watchdog had given the crisis ridden information technology group one day to reply to the questions on its half year accounts for 1996.

Consob suspended Olivetti shares from trading on the Milan bourse on Thursday and Friday while it sought clarification on a claim by an former Olivetti manager that the accounts did not paint the whole picture of the group's financial state.
Shares resumed trade on Monday morning after Olivetti issued a statement sticking by the figures but Consob said it wanted to make further inquiries.
